included: Pinned Dovekie data and likelihood provenance
Row order, units, redshift range, covariance properties
excluded: Changes to shared reports, ledger, RUN_STATE, or experiment code

provenance.commit_message: Update README.md; clarify covariance matrices are already inverted
provenance.pin_kind: full Git commit, not a tag
provenance.verification: Queried official GitHub commit tree metadata without fetching data payloads; local git hash-object values match the upstream blob IDs.

data_contract.file_format: SNANA whitespace VARNAMES/SN records, despite .csv suffix; no commas
data_contract.official_filter: zHD > 0.00; all rows pass and order is unchanged

redshift_semantics.zHD: CMB-frame/Hubble-diagram redshift with peculiar-velocity correction; used for D_A interpolation

data_contract.MU_convention: Distance modulus in magnitudes; release assumes H0=70, while SN likelihood retains an unconstrained constant magnitude/H0 offset.
data_contract.MUERR_role: Diagnostic/stat error field; do not add separately to released STAT+SYS covariance.

archive.stored_quantity: upper triangle of inverse full STAT+SYS covariance P=C^-1

data_contract.mapping: Verified exact local-to-upstream Git blob identity and release README pairing/order warning; do not sort or use the metadata table.

likelihood.released_offset_marginalization: For d=g-y and P=C^-1: Q=d^T P d-(1^T P d)^2/(1^T P 1), plus log[(1^T P 1)/(2*pi)] in the likelihood helper; fixed log|C| is added by the Gaussian base.
likelihood.h0: M is fully degenerate with H0; do not infer H0 from Dovekie alone.
mismatches: Code defaults refer to DES-SN5YR_HD.csv and STAT+SYS.txt.gz, rather than Dovekie's DES-Dovekie_HD.csv and STAT+SYS.npz.
Code calls Table.read(format='ascii.csv'), but the exact paired data is SNANA whitespace. Use a format adapter and explicit Dovekie paths.
Release README has a likely typo DES-SN55YR_HD.csv in its ordering note; the exact upstream data asset is DES-Dovekie_HD.csv.
likelihood.execution: Inspected exact pinned source; CosmoSIS not run by this audit.

requirements: Freeze shape theta from BAO only.
Predeclare disjoint nonempty training T and held-out block H.
Use full C and preserve identical row mapping in vectors/matrices.
Integrate one flat-prior M using training rows only.

covariance_space.rank_one_term: a_H a_H^T/q_T, with covariance-space vector a_H=1_H-C_HT C_TT^-1 1_T

precision_space_equivalent.warning: P_TT alone is not the marginal training precision. Use the Schur complement and stable Cholesky solves.

conditional_redshift_block.plug_in_difference: Plugging in Mhat_T and scoring only with S_H drops the intercept-posterior rank-one variance and is not the flat-prior-marginalized predictive score.
score_limits: Leave-one-block-out conditional scores are valid individually but are not additive.

For an additive sequence, designate an intercept-calibration anchor and score later blocks conditionally; the first block has no normalized predictive density under an improper flat prior unless M has a proper prior.
Do not use held-out rows to estimate M. Conditional scoring is a predictive diagnostic, not a second independent likelihood.

overlap_and_independence.desi_sn_cross_covariance: No cross-probe covariance is provided by the audited products. A BAO*SN likelihood product assumes zero cross-covariance; common sky/cosmic volume could still correlate them.
overlap_and_independence.double_counting: Do not multiply by original DES-SN5YR or a Dovekie chain/joint summary already containing Dovekie and/or DESI factors.

recommendation.status: Proceed with a path/format adapter, exact row order, full STAT+SYS, frozen BAO shape, and the rank-one intercept-marginalized conditional predictive covariance. Label zero BAO-SN cross-covariance as an approximation.
